entities.name: Francisco Mosquera

entities.summary: Francisco Antonio Mosquera Valencia is a Colombian weightlifter, former World Champion, three-time Pan American Champion and Pan American Games Champion competing in the 62 kg category until 2018 and 61 kg starting in 2018 after the International Weightlifting Federation reorganized the categories.
